{{Top|leg}}
'''First executive''' was the title of the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] leader of [[Tallaan]]. The first executive was chosen by the world's [[Trade Commission (Tallaan)|ruling council]], elected from their own ranks. The council itself had been elected via popular vote.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
